original_test_intent: Verify before/after versions for BMC and the explicitly named BIOS, lower-GPUBB FPGA and upper-GPUBB FPGA components against the approved firmware package and component mapping.
original_method: Capture same-SUT WebUI and vendor-defined read-only raw responses before and after a separately governed firmware operation, validate completion and decode each response using the approved component schema.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the vendor command contract and target manifest and separately governs any flash. An operator verifies same-SUT before/after identity; automation can execute only approved read-only queries and comparisons.
required_inputs: Exact read-only raw commands and response schema
safety_requirements: Do not flash, reset, power-cycle or clear logs
Verify the same SUT at both checkpoints
Stop on malformed response or component mismatch
Require independent recovery controls for external flashing
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Run only approved read-only WebUI/API/raw queries
Validate completion, length, byte order and decode
Compare all named components with the manifest and before/after record
Report without performing firmware operations or deciding the verdict
engineer_actions: Supply the vendor specification, decoder and package manifest
Provide or approve the separate flash/recovery workflow
Confirm component scope and checkpoint identity

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Completely inapplicable: outlet sensor reads belong to duplicate row 771 and do not query firmware.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Resolve each `[Follow BMC SPEC]` placeholder to an approved read-only request and reviewed decoder; do not execute guessed raw bytes or combine flashing into this case.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All named components, before/after criterion, Script and 5/5-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a component-keyed before/after matrix with raw response, completion code, decoder version, decoded value and target comparison.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Separates observation from firmware mutation and makes raw decoding auditable.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; BMC, BIOS and both GPUBB FPGA entries remain explicit.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A guessed raw request may invoke the wrong function; a separately executed flash can make management unavailable.

project_override_considerations: A project may provide supported Redfish/UI fields instead of raw requests where they cover the same components and values, but must document equivalence and may not silently omit either GPUBB or the before/after checkpoint.
expected_evidence: Redacted raw and decoded before/after values for BMC, BIOS and both GPUBBs
No-mutation proof and no hardware PASS claim

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item names BMC firmware and the procedure explicitly expands the version inventory to BIOS and both GPUBBs; this is broader scope, not mutually exclusive behavior. Duplicate row 771 is isolated.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The vendor commands, decoder, manifest and external checkpoints are finite package inputs; once supplied, read-only verification is executable.

review_improvement: Eliminates outlet-sensor contamination, refuses placeholder raw execution and separates the observable version check from any high-risk flash operation.
independent_technical_reasoning: All required observations are identifiable, but neither command bytes nor target values are provided. Those are normal vendor package inputs. Since firmware mutation is not needed to perform the reads and can remain separately controlled, REQUIRES is the appropriate boundary.
